create_GPT_model: create a GPT model instance to call OpenAI chat completions with configurable temperature and max tokens
call_GPT_prompt: call the GPT model with a prompt and optional system message to get a text response
get_GPT_cost: get the estimated cost of a GPT API call based on prompt and response token counts
create_Gemini_model: create a Gemini model instance to call Google Generative AI with configurable safety settings
get_Gemini_cost: get the estimated cost of a Gemini API call based on prompt and response token counts
